tests.title: A cancellation less than 24 hours ahead goes through only after the caller accepts the $50 fee

caller.persona: James O'Connor, 68, a patient of the clinic.
caller.goal: Cancel your appointment today; something came up at work. If you are told about a fee, agree to pay it. Stay on the line until the assistant confirms the appointment is cancelled.
